title: Securable requirements contract (.securable/requirements.yaml)
description: Repo-resident, machine-readable securability requirements. Emitted by prd-securability-enhancement, consumed by any code-generation harness, verified at merge review. FIASSE v1.1 S4.1 (Clear Expectations) made durable. Requirements must be implementable with testable acceptance criteria — never bare control citations (S6.1.1).

asvs_level.description: Baseline ASVS 5.0 assurance level chosen for the system.

generated_by.description: Tool/skill that emitted or last updated this file.

cross_cutting.description: Requirements spanning multiple features (central logging, secrets policy, TLS baseline).

boundaries.description: Boundary ids crossed by this feature; validated against .securable/boundaries.yaml when present.

text.description: The implementable requirement, in plain language.

asvs.description: ASVS 5.0 references; validated against the bundled catalog by scripts/validate_securable.py.

level.description: The requirement's own ASVS level, when it differs from the baseline.

escalation.description: Required true when level exceeds asvs_level — above-baseline items are explicit escalations, never silent baseline.

acceptance.description: Behaviorally testable acceptance criteria — a test or audit can confirm pass/fail.

status.description: planned: written, not built. implemented: a generator/author claims the code satisfies it. verified: a review or test run confirmed the acceptance criteria — only reviews/CI flip to verified, never the generator.

evidence.description: What confirmed it (file:line, test name, report reference). Required when status is verified.
